leadText: The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twentieth season of , Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, in and ( ).
plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twentieth season of , Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, in and ( ).

==Partial collections==
Two Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon Collections were released by in 2017 and 2018, containing the whole season between them.

===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1===
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1 was released by in Australia on December 6, 2017 and in New Zealand on December 13, 2017. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7788.

====Contents====
 
 

===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 2===
 
Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 2 was released by in Australia on February 7, 2018 and in New Zealand on February 21, 2018. It contains three discs with 21 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7789.

====Contents====
 
 

==Season 20 disc set==
 
The Season 20 DigiPack disc set, also referred to as Pokémon The Series: Sun & Moon Complete Collection in promotional material, was released by in Australia on May 2, 2018 and in New Zealand on May 16, 2018. It contains six discs with 43 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE7790.
 

===Contents===
Each disc features artwork of one or more specific Pokémon on the disc itself.
 

==Multi-season releases==
The following are English language Region 4 multi-season releases that include Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon episodes.
Pokémon Seasons 1-20: Ultra Collection
Pokémon Seasons 1-21: Mega Collection

==Trivia==
Some retail sites and the Beyond Home Entertainment site display a different cover for Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1.
Prior to its release, Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 2 used a different cover featuring .

 
Sun and Moon Collection 1 alternate.png|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 1 alternate cover
Sun and Moon Collection 2 prerelease.png|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon - Collection 2 pre-release cover
